name: Badge Notification
project_description: Badge Notification shows small dynamic status/count badges to logged-in users for new or updated content, computed from Drupal core's history table and loaded asynchronously so page caching is unaffected. It adds a hidden 'Content status' extra field to every content type that renders a 'New'/'Updated' marker on the node, and lets you attach unread-count badges to menu links driven by a chosen View. A JavaScript behavior collects the placeholders on the page and posts them to a single JSON controller, which runs the matching BadgeNotification plugin and returns the rendered badge markup for each placeholder. It ships three plugins (node_is_new, views_count_new, views_has_new) and can be extended with custom plugins via the badge_notification annotation plugin type.
